brief:
Family affairs expert Abdel Nasser Frowana told Shehab Wire that Palestinian women remain targeted by the occupation without exception, regardless of their social circumstances, physical vulnerability, or health conditions. Frowana, a specialist in prisoner affairs, said women face systematic targeting that disregards their particular circumstances.

The expert said Israeli forces have shown no distinction in their treatment of Palestinian women, affecting them across all social and physical conditions without apparent restraint.

title: Occupation targets Palestinian women without exception or restraint
